name: Mueller's Enriched Elbow Macaroni (Well-Cooked & Soft)
whyItWorks: Classic enriched semolina macaroni elbows cooked past al dente to fully hydrate starch granules. Gentle on inflamed intestinal walls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil for 8–9 minutes in salted water until soft. Drain and serve with a pat of butter, olive oil, or smooth lactose-free cheddar sauce.
